segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Hearing of the Committee on Finance, Subcommittee G, is hereby called to order. The agenda is the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the National Irrigation Administration. I understand some of our colleagues will be following.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: But even as we hear this committee hearing, meron na po tayong continuing quorum because the mother committee suspended its hearings, and this likewise covers the subcommittee. May I now call our committee secretary, Attorney Philip Lina, to acknowledge and place on record our resource persons.

segments.text: Thank you. Bago tayo mag-umpisa ng presentation ng NIA, allow me to place on record our opening statement.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Magandang umaga sa inyo, Engineer Guillen, Administrator, sa lahat ng ating mga kasamahan sa NIA.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: NIA, malapit sa aking puso ang NIA dahil marami naman sigurong nakakaalala sa inyo dati akong naging chairman ng inyong board.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Sa mga hearing natin para sa 2027 budget, tatlong major context ang ating pagtutuunan ng pansin.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang Super El Nino na inaantabayanan natin, darating na hanggang next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Nito'ng nakaraang buwan sa Central Luzon, Northern Luzon at Southern Luzon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: At ang public clamor para sa accountability sa mga goals and substandard infrastructure projects, particular sa flood control.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ngayon sa hearing natin sa budget ng NIA, ang tanong natin ay paano ipapaabot ng bawat piso?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Sa totoong maliliit na magsasaka, totoong sakahan at totoong proyektong gumagana.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: At lagi ko itong binabanggit, anong saisay nung billion kung ang mga magsasaka ay patuloy nabaon sa utang?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Binibigyang diin ko rin ito noon nung ako ang chairman ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Wala tayong lahat dito kung wala nang nagsasaka.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang trabaho natin sa NIA ay dahil may mga magsasakang nagsasaka araw-araw.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: At pagka naging endangered species na ang mga magsasaka, dahil 57, 56, 55 years old na sila at wala nang magsasaka sa susunod na henerasyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: eh wala na rin saisay ang NIA.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: At wala nang saisay ang bawat isa na nagtatrabaho sa NIA.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: We are here because we are serving our farmers.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And as I always stress, kahit na billion-billion ang ginagastos natin, dapat ang dulo nito, tumataas ang kita ng ating mga magsasaka.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kung hindi, hindi na silang magsasaka, eh wala na rin tayong trabaho sa NIA.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang panukalang budget ng NIA na 46.36 billion ay 27% lower.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang nakakabahala, 58% ang bawas sa pondo para sa restoration ng irrigation systems.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ilang buwan nang nagsasabi ang mga scientist natin sa pag-asa na darating ang napakalakas na El Niño sa huling buwan ng 2026 hanggang sa unang anim na buwan ng 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kaya hindi ngayon ang panahon para magtipid sa kanal.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pumps, reservoir, communal irrigation at pagkukumpuni ng irrigation systems.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Walang accomplishment kung walang tubig na umaabot sa sakahan at walang infrastructure kung hanggang papel lang ang proyekto, lalong-lalo na sa panahon ng El Niño.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: I recall the interventions of then-administrator Renzi Pardernal during the 2014-2015.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: El Niño, which was the worst actually until today as we anticipate the next round of El Niño.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pinakamatinding El Niño yun noong panahon na yun. Mula pa nun hanggang sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pero hindi tayo napag-iwanan. Pinangunahan natin, nangayalam tayo, tiniyak natin na yung ating mga proyekto at programa ay nakatuon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Handa ang agri-sector, ang irrigation administration, ang ating mga irrigators association.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Handa sa pagtama ng El Niño.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kung nagawa natin noon, walang dahilan na hindi natin magagawa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kailangan natin mapatuloy ang full transparency rin at tunay na accountability sa mga geotag, dapat geotag, na mga proyekto.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Bukas sa publiko ang mga kontrata, may independent quality testing at may public dashboard na maaaring subaybayan ng lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Higit sa lahat, dapat magbayad lamang ang gobyerno kapag napatunayang maayos, kumpleto at gumagana ang mga proyekto.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: At pinapatawan ng mga penalties ang mga hindi nakukumplento sa tamang panahon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ito ang dahilan kung bakit ipinaglaban natin ang SPEC.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ito ang special provision para sa isang full transparency portal.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Tanong ngayon, naitayo na ba ito?

NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Our Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Proposal is firmly anchored in the 7-point strategic agenda.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: It serves as the strategic framework guiding the agency's priorities and investment.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: The 7 strategic agenda include Irrigation Infrastructure Development,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Number 3, the Climate Smart Farming Systems,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: and Number 6, Capability Building of Human Resources,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: and Number 7, Strategic Communication and Advocacy.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: These strategic priorities ensure that NIA investments

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Go beyond the construction and rehabilitation of facilities.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: They also focus on strengthening farmers' organizations,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: NIA aims to deliver sustainable irrigation services

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: that contribute to increased agricultural productivity,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: and improve livelihoods for Filipino farmers.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: The National Irrigation Master Plan, NIMP, 2020-2030,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: serves as the country's strategic blueprint for irrigation development.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: It provides a comprehensive framework for expanding and modernizing irrigation systems

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: to increase irrigated agricultural areas, enhance farm productivity,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: enhance food security, and help reduce poverty in rural communities.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Aligned with the NIMP, the NIA overarching objective is to contribute to food security

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: and poverty reduction through accelerated and sustained irrigation development

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: under diversified and climate-resilient crop production systems.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: By providing reliable and efficient irrigation services,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: NIA enables farmers to increase cropping efficiency,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: reduce vulnerability to drought and other climate-related risks,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: and ultimately raise farm incomes and improve their quality of life.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: NIA updated the country's potential irrigable area

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: through the Regional Irrigation Master Plan,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: incorporating the latest geospatial and technical data from

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: agencies such as the BSWM, DENR, NWRB, PHIVOLCS, and NCIP.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: This ensures that irrigation investments are guided and more accurate

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: and validated data and directed toward areas with greatest development potential.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen

segments.text: Kaya nga po ang suggestion namin is if it's possible to do away with the Annex A, ang tawag po na kasi namin Annex A. In the NEP, there is now an annex for the sub-programs of the NIA.

segments.text: Pero tandaan, hindi kayang pigilan ng isang dam ang lahat ng baha. Basin-wide ang flood risk.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Nakadepende ito sa rainfall, watershed runoff, river capacity, drainage, debris at kondisyon ng downstream areas.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Sa Stoto Cristo Dam, nakita natin kung paano maaaring dagdagan ng debris at malaking volume ng tubig ang pressure sa downstream system.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
Presentation video
segments.text: monitoring, maintenance at rehabilitation ng ating existing dams at irrigation facilities.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Kaya nagpapatuloy ang improvement at rehabilitation projects para maging mas reliable at resilient ang ating irrigation infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Dahil ang layunin ay hindi lamang tubig para sa irrigation, kundi isang water management system na mas maaasahan, mas ligtas at mas resilient para sa Central Luzon.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Kung ipakita ninyo yung map, para i-explain ko lang kay Mr. Cherio, yung map ng Bulacan muna sir, para mas madali.

segments.text: Kasi apat lang ang ilog ng Bulacan.

segments.text: Yung Bulacan po, apat po ang tributaris naman nandito, bumabagsak na ilog sa Bulacan.

segments.text: Ang isa po, pinakamalaki is yung Norsagaray River.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Ito pong Norsagaray River, wala na tayong problema rito dahil nandyan na po yung Anggat Dam.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: In fact, during po nung Munzon, hindi po nag-release ng tubig ang Anggat Dam.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: In fact, hanggang ngayon, kulang pa po ang laman niyang tubig.

segments.text: Nag-release lang ng tubig itong Ipo.

segments.text: Kasi yung Ipo Dam na nandyan, parang diversion dam lamang po siya.

segments.text: Ito po yung ginagamit na diversion dam, papunta po sa Lamesa Dam.
